description: What a customer asked to buy, captured by the public purchase form before any money moves. It exists so the Web Form has an honest target: a form cannot collect an item, a quantity and an email address onto a Sales Invoice, whose items are a child table and which has no email field, and pretending otherwise produces a form that saves nothing. The Sales Invoice is raised FROM this record, server-side, so the buyer never chooses the item, the rate or the accounts.

fields.description: The Sales Invoice raised for this request. Created by the server, never by the form, so the item, the rate, the company and the accounts are all the deployment's choice.
fields.label: Sales Invoice

fields.description: The Rest purchase reference, carried through to the invoice so a payment can be matched back to the deployment that asked for it.
fields.label: Purchase Reference

fields.description: Where the receipt goes, and how the buyer can be reached about this purchase.
fields.label: Buyer Email

fields.description: Segments for SMS, messages for email.
fields.label: Units

fields.description: What the buyer is paying. The invoice is raised for THIS amount rather than recomputed, so the price a customer agreed to is the price on the invoice.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Where this buyer was sent to pay. Recorded because a buyer who reached the gateway and one who never left the form need different follow-up.
fields.label: Payment URL

name: Rest Credit Purchase
